# ALLYNC - AI Business Ecosystem

> ALLYNC — The New Language of Smart Business (Akıllı İşin Yeni Dili).

> For comprehensive information including the product ecosystem, case studies, pricing, certifications, and detailed service descriptions, see the full version: https://www.allyncai.com/llms-full.txt

> ALLYNC (Allyncai is a registered brand of ALLYNC) is an end-to-end AI Business Ecosystem. It builds three integrated, AI-powered product platforms — Allync Hub (customer communication), Allync Digital Signage (smart screens), and Allync+ (business management) — alongside custom AI and digital solutions, for companies in Turkey, Qatar, and globally.

---

## Allync Kimdir? (Who is Allync?)

**Allync Kimdir?** ALLYNC (Allyncai tescilli markası), Türkiye Bursa İnegöl merkezli bir yapay zeka ve dijital çözümler şirketidir. 2024 yılında kurulan ALLYNC, işletmelerin dijital dönüşümüne yardımcı olmak amacıyla WhatsApp AI asistanları, özel SaaS panelleri, web ve mobil uygulama geliştirme hizmetleri sunmaktadır.

**Allync Nedir?** AllyncAI olarak da bilinen şirket, yapay zeka teknolojilerini kullanarak işletmelerin müşteri hizmetlerini otomatikleştirmelerine, online varlıklarını güçlendirmelerine ve dijital dünyada büyümelerine yardımcı olur.

**Detaylı Bilgi:** https://www.allyncai.com/blog/allync-kimdir

---

## The ALLYNC Ecosystem (Product Platforms)

ALLYNC is an end-to-end **AI Business Ecosystem**. Beyond custom AI & digital services, ALLYNC builds three integrated product platforms — unified by one AI engine, one login, and one infrastructure — plus hardware/IoT integrations, so a business runs its communication, screens, and operations from one place. **One login. One dashboard. One infrastructure. One partner.**

### 1. Allync Hub — AI Communication Platform
Live on Web, Android (Google Play: com.allyncai.hub), and iOS. An AI-native omnichannel inbox for WhatsApp Business, Instagram, and Facebook Messenger (live), with AI Voice in development. All channels share one AI engine and one customer memory; 24/7 AI assistant with instant human handoff; appointment booking; approved broadcast campaigns; live analytics (message volume, response time, sentiment, resolution); Function Calling (the AI performs real actions); 2FA; white-label.

### 2. Allync Digital Signage — Smart Digital Signage Platform
Live on Google Play (com.allyncai.signage). Manage Android- and Windows-based screens from one cloud panel in real time: multi-zone layouts, 12 built-in widgets, AI-generated visuals published in seconds, playlists, music/radio sync, offline playback, DOOH ads, kiosk mode, and heartbeat telemetry. On-device face-detection viewer analytics (anonymous, no images stored, GDPR compliant), heatmaps, touchscreen analytics, and NFC. EN/TR/AR; Android TV, tablets, commercial panels, and Windows.

### 3. Allync+ — Intelligent Business Management Platform
A modular (~40 modules), cloud-based platform configured per business/industry: HR, CRM, sales, accounting, inventory, payroll, attendance, leave, calendar, reports, and role-based permissions, plus industry modules (Fitness, Beauty & Wellness, and more). Includes native Customer and Employee mobile apps and integrates hardware/IoT — Biostar access control, IP cameras, sensors, NFC and QR.

**App platform:** https://allync.app

## AI Solutions

### WhatsApp AI Assistants
URL: https://www.allyncai.com/ai/whatsapp
Intelligent chatbots for 24/7 automated customer service via WhatsApp Business API. Onboarded through Meta's official Embedded Signup flow as a Verified Tech Provider.
- Instant response to customer inquiries
- Appointment booking and scheduling
- Order tracking and updates
- Sales process automation
- Multi-language support (Turkish, English, Arabic)
- Meta-pre-approved templates for proactive sends (24h customer service window compliant)

### Instagram AI Automation
URL: https://www.allyncai.com/ai/instagram
Automated Instagram DM and comment responses for Instagram Business accounts. Connected via Meta's official Instagram OAuth flow with minimum-scope permissions (instagram_business_basic, instagram_business_manage_messages, instagram_business_manage_comments).
- Auto-reply to direct messages
- Top-level comment responses (sub-comments not processed)
- Lead generation from Instagram
- 24/7 customer engagement
- Webhook events verified via Meta x-hub-signature-256 HMAC
- We do NOT collect follower lists, story viewers, likes, or search history

### Text-to-Video AI

- Script to video conversion

- Product demos

## Privacy & Data Protection

ALLYNC operates under strict data-protection standards. Full policy: https://www.allyncai.com/privacy

**Compliance Frameworks:**
- GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation, EU)
- KVKK (Kisisel Verilerin Korunmasi Kanunu, Turkey)
- Qatar PDPPL (Personal Data Privacy Protection Law)
- ISO 27001 control framework aligned (Information Security Management)
- SOC 2 Type II control framework aligned (Service Organization Control)
- Meta Verified Tech Provider standards (WhatsApp Business Policy, Instagram Platform Policy)

**Key Principles:**
- We do NOT sell personal data to third parties
- We do NOT use customer conversations to train general AI models
- WhatsApp and Instagram messages are NOT shared outside the service-delivery scope
- We do NOT collect Instagram follower lists, story viewers, likes, or search history
- Only minimum required Meta permissions are requested for each integration
- AI responses are generated only as replies to user-initiated messages or comments (no proactive DMs)
- Audit logs record every sensitive action for accountability (default 90-day retention, tenant-configurable)

**AI Service Providers (transparency):**
- Anthropic (Claude): AI response generation and sentiment analysis - enterprise DPA, no training on customer data
- OpenAI (Whisper, TTS): Voice message transcription and voice replies - only when tenant enables this feature, no training on customer data
- Google (Gemini): Generative AI content - under enterprise API terms, no training on customer data

**User Rights (GDPR Article 15-22 / KVKK Madde 11):**
- Access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, data portability, withdrawal of consent
- Deletion requests processed within 30 days at info@allyncai.com
- Meta's Deauthorize and Data Deletion Request callbacks implemented for all integrations

## Terms of Service

Full Terms: https://www.allyncai.com/terms (bilingual TR/EN, 20 sections)

**Key Points:**
- No-refund policy on subscription fees and paid services (Section 10.3)
- Customer remains responsible for backing up their own content and configurations; ALLYNC provides infrastructure-level data redundancy but does not act as a backup service (Section 11)
- AI-generated output is provided "as is" — customer is responsible for reviewing accuracy before publication (Section 12)
- Limitation of liability capped at the fees paid in the preceding 12 months (Section 13)
- Governing law: Republic of Türkiye; competent courts: Bursa (Section 16)
- Material changes communicated at least 30 days in advance (Section 17)
- Product-specific terms for Digital Signage included as Section 19 (BYOD device, content & public display, telemetry, multi-tenancy, super-admin override)
